articles.title: Netflix unveils teaser of IAF Kargil drama series “Operation Safed Sagar”
articles.summary: Netflix is set to release 'Operation Safed Sagar,' an upcoming series detailing the Indian Air Force's crucial role during the Kargil War. This 'untold saga' aims to shed light on the IAF's strategic air operations, providing insights into their valor and challenges faced. Such narratives are vital for understanding India's military history and inspiring future defence aspirants.

articles.title: January Transfer Window: Biggest Winners And Losers
articles.summary: The 2026 winter football transfer window recently closed on Monday. The most significant deal on deadline day was Jorgen Strand Larsen's $66 million transfer from Wolves to Crystal Palace. Despite this substantial transaction, the overall activity during the window was characterized as relatively tame, indicating a quieter period for player movements in professional football.

articles.title: Two arrested on suspicion of sabotaging German warships
articles.summary: German authorities have arrested two workers, including a Romanian national, on suspicion of sabotaging several German warships at Hamburg harbour. This incident, confirmed by the prosecutor general's office, underscores critical vulnerabilities in naval asset security. It highlights the paramount importance of robust security protocols for military installations and equipment against potential threats.

articles.title: SpaceX–xAI merger bets big on orbital AI, raises strategic questions for India
articles.summary: SpaceX has acquired xAI, forming a colossal $1.25 trillion entity ahead of SpaceX's anticipated IPO this year. This strategic merger isn't just corporate maneuvering; it's seen as a blueprint for the future of technology, especially in orbital applications. For SSB aspirants, this signifies the accelerating integration of AI with space technology, which could profoundly influence future defence and strategic capabilities.

articles.title: India, Tanzania agree on cooperation between air forces
articles.summary: India and Tanzania held a key bilateral meeting in New Delhi, focusing on significantly boosting defence cooperation. Discussions covered a broad range of areas vital for regional stability, including enhanced military training programs and strengthening maritime security. This collaboration aims to bolster both nations' capabilities and reinforce strategic partnerships in the Indian Ocean region, crucial for security aspirants.

articles.title: India-EU FTA in final legal scrubbing stage, likely to come into force this year: EU envoy
articles.summary: India and the European Union are actively progressing their Free Trade Agreement (FTA), currently in the crucial 'legal scrubbing' stage. Both sides are committed to swiftly concluding this process to facilitate its signing and implementation. This accelerated finalization underscores the mutual desire to strengthen economic ties and boost trade between India and the EU.

articles.title: After 86 Years, DC Unveils Permanent New Superpower for Green Lantern Ahead of HBO's Lanterns
articles.summary: The article details DC's Green Lanterns, known for their incredible feats and unique Power Rings. The comic publisher consistently introduces new abilities and innovative methods for Lanterns to utilize their rings, expanding their willpower-driven powers. These updates enhance the versatility of their energy constructs and further develop the cosmic mythos surrounding these iconic characters within the DC universe.
